description: This file defines data models related to notes within a note-taking application, including entity representation for database storage (`NoteEntity`) and a domain model (`Note`). It includes properties related to note content, metadata, relationships with tags and reminders, and utility methods for content processing.

classes.name: NoteEntity
classes.description: Data class representing the note entity for database storage with Room, including foreign key relationship to Notebook.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data class representing the note within the application domain, with properties for content, metadata, relationships, and utility functions.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the note is empty, considering title, content, attachments, reminders, tags, and task list.

methods.name: stringToTaskList
methods.description: Converts the note content into a list of NoteTask objects based on line parsing.

methods.name: mdToTaskList
methods.description: Parses markdown list syntax in provided content to generate a list of NoteTask objects.

methods.name: toStorableContent
methods.description: Returns the content suitable for storage, converting task list to markdown if necessary.

methods.name: taskListToMd
methods.description: Converts the task list to markdown list syntax.

methods.name: taskListToString
methods.description: Converts task list to a string representation, optionally including checkmarks.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts the domain model Note to its database entity form NoteEntity.
